content.body:
Most screens in Battleground Europe will have multiple tabs. The left-most tab is usually the primary tab for the current screen.
While playing offline, the primary tab is the vehicle list. You can select vehicles and view a brief about each vehicle.
The THEATER MAP tab will open the map of the game world.
The MANUALS tab gives contains detailed information about each combat unit and other useful information.
The SETTINGS tab allows you to change game preferences, such as video and sound settings, keymaps and joystick configurations.
content.title: Navigation Tabs
